run_cnt_baseline: run the raw count model baseline on a corpus of Hearst patterns for hypernymy evaluation
run_ppmi_baseline: run the PPMI model baseline on a corpus of Hearst patterns for hypernymy evaluation
run_svdppmi_baseline: run the SVD-PPMI model with k dimensions on a corpus of Hearst patterns
run_unsupervised_baseline: run an unsupervised baseline like weeds or cosine on a corpus of Hearst patterns
run_slqs_baseline: run the SLQS model with k dimensions on a corpus of Hearst patterns for hypernymy evaluation
